{"PROG_ID": "select_measure", "QUERY_ID": "FP\Common\Measure", "QUERY_SEQ": "0", "INST_SEQ": "0", "QUERY_VALUE": "---Service Parameter : 0USER_ID
---Service Parameter : 1MENU_ID
---Check client parameter : USER_ID
---FOUND USER_ID
-- TYPE = nvarchar---Add string Service
---Check client parameter : MENU_ID
---FOUND MENU_ID
-- TYPE = nvarchar---Add string Service

    	 WITH M_TABLE AS (
					   		SELECT SEGMENT1     AS USER_ID  			
									, SEGMENT2     AS MENU_ID  			
									, SEGMENT3     AS MEA_ID 		  	         													
									, SEGMENT4     AS MEA_NAME													
									, SEGMENT5     AS MEA_VALUE          
									, ATTRIBUTE1   AS TYPE                   
									, ATTRIBUTE2   AS FLAG               
									, ATTRIBUTE3   AS ACTIVE_FLAG       
					     	FROM   	SCM_SYS_LOOKUP_VALUE A WITH(NOLOCK)
						    WHERE  	A.LOOKUP_TYPE_CODE = 'UI_AMEND_MEASURE'
						    AND     A.SEGMENT2 = @MENU_ID
						    AND 	A.ACTIVE_FLAG = 'Y'
			   )
			 SELECT * FROM (SELECT   ISNULL(A.MEA_ID, B.MEA_ID) MEA_ID
						,ISNULL(B.MEA_NAME, A.MEA_NAME) MEA_NAME
						,ISNULL(B.MEA_VALUE, A.MEA_VALUE) MEA_VALUE
						,ISNULL(B.TYPE, A.TYPE) TYPE
						,ISNULL(B.FLAG, A.FLAG) FLAG
						,A.MENU_ID
						,@USER_ID AS USER_ID
			FROM   M_TABLE A WITH(NOLOCK)
			LEFT OUTER JOIN (
			    SELECT *
			    FROM   TH_UIS_USER_AMEND_MEA_RELATE B WITH(NOLOCK)
			    WHERE  USER_ID = @USER_ID
			    AND    MENU_ID = @MENU_ID
			    AND    ACTIVE_FLAG = 'Y'
			) B
			ON    A.MENU_ID = B.MENU_ID
			AND   A.MEA_ID  = B.MEA_ID
			AND   A.TYPE 	= B.TYPE
			WHERE 1=1
			AND   A.ACTIVE_FLAG = 'Y') B
GROUP BY MEA_ID, MEA_NAME, MEA_VALUE, TYPE, FLAG, MENU_ID, USER_ID
    
      ", "JOB_TYPE": "read", "START_TIME": "2026-11-13 04:44:52", "END_TIME": "2026-11-13 04:44:53", "INSERT_ID": "jaeuk.shin", "LOG_TYPE": "SQL", "IP_ADDRESS": "100.113.200.36", "SESSION_ID": "20261113044452_962", "PARAM_VALUE": "{USER_ID : jaeuk.shin MENU_ID : FP00609_Main }", "DUR_TIME": "72", "ATTRIBUTE1": "GeneralExecuteQuery", "ATTRIBUTE2": "", "ATTRIBUTE3": "", "ATTRIBUTE4": "", "ATTRIBUTE5": ""}

              ,YYYYMMDD AS _DATE

              ,MONTH AS _MONTH
              ,SUBSTRING(YYYYMMDD,1,4) + '-' + SUBSTRING(YYYYMMDD,5,2) + '-' + SUBSTRING(YYYYMMDD,7,2) + ' '
              +(CASE WHEN DAY_SEQ=2 THEN '(Mon.)'
                     WHEN DAY_SEQ=3 THEN '(Tue.)'
                     WHEN DAY_SEQ=4 THEN '(Wed.)'
                     WHEN DAY_SEQ=5 THEN '(Thu.)'
                     WHEN DAY_SEQ=6 THEN '(Fri.)'

                     ELSE '(SUN.)' END)
              AS _DATE_TXT
              ,DAY_SEQ
        FROM   TH_UIS_CAL A WITH(NOLOCK)
        WHERE  YYYYMMDD BETWEEN @BUCKET_FROM AND @BUCKET_TO

      SELECT YYYYMM AS MONTH

             (CASE WHEN MONTH = '01' THEN 'Jan'
                   WHEN MONTH = '02' THEN 'Feb'
                   WHEN MONTH = '03' THEN 'Mar'
                   WHEN MONTH = '04' THEN 'Apr'
                   WHEN MONTH = '05' THEN 'May'
                   WHEN MONTH = '06' THEN 'Jun'

                   WHEN MONTH = '08' THEN 'Aug'
                   WHEN MONTH = '09' THEN 'Sep'
                   WHEN MONTH = '10' THEN 'Oct'

                   ELSE 'Dec' END) AS MONTH_NAME
           , COUNT(*) AS MONTH_COUNT
           , 'M' + CONVERT(VARCHAR,(ROW_NUMBER() OVER(ORDER BY YYYYMM))-1) AS M_VALUE
      FROM   TH_UIS_CAL AS CAL WITH(NOLOCK)
      WHERE  CAL.DT >= CONVERT(DATETIME, @BUCKET_FROM, 112)
      AND    CAL.DT <= CONVERT(DATETIME, @BUCKET_TO, 112)
      GROUP BY YYYYMM, MONTH
      ORDER BY YYYYMM

---Check client parameter : PLAN_NAME

					SELECT 	A.*
					FROM 	(
								SELECT 	YYYYMMDD AS _DATE
									    ,SUBSTRING(YYYYMMDD,1,4) + '-' + SUBSTRING(YYYYMMDD,5,2) + '-' + SUBSTRING(YYYYMMDD,7,2) + ' '
									    +(CASE WHEN DAY_SEQ=2 THEN '(Mon)'
									           WHEN DAY_SEQ=3 THEN '(Tue)'
									           WHEN DAY_SEQ=4 THEN '(Wed)'
									           WHEN DAY_SEQ=5 THEN '(Thu)'
									           WHEN DAY_SEQ=6 THEN '(Fri)'
									           WHEN DAY_SEQ=7 THEN '(Sat)'
									           ELSE '(SUN)' END)
									    AS _NAME
									    , 1 AS _COUNT
									    ,'D' + CONVERT(VARCHAR,(ROW_NUMBER() OVER(ORDER BY YYYYMMDD))-1) AS _VALUE
									    , 1 AS _DATE_SEQ
									    , ISO_YYYYWW AS WEEK_SEQ
									    , 'D' AS _TYPE
								FROM   TH_UIS_CAL A WITH(NOLOCK)
								WHERE  YYYYMMDD BETWEEN @BUCKET_FROM AND @BUCKET_TO
								UNION ALL
								SELECT ISO_YYYYWW AS _DATE
									   , (SUBSTRING(ISO_YYYYWW,1,4) + 'W' + SUBSTRING(ISO_YYYYWW,5,2)) AS _NAME
									   , COUNT(*) AS _COUNT
									   , 'W' + CONVERT(VARCHAR,(ROW_NUMBER() OVER(ORDER BY ISO_YYYYWW))-1) AS _VALUE
									   , 1 AS _DATE_SEQ
									   , ISO_YYYYWW AS WEEK_SEQ
									   , 'W' AS _TYPE
								FROM   TH_UIS_CAL AS CAL WITH(NOLOCK)
								WHERE  CAL.DT >= CONVERT(DATETIME, @BUCKET_FROM, 112)
								AND    CAL.DT <= CONVERT(DATETIME, @BUCKET_TO, 112)
